open_points.subject: Action `resolve an unknown outcome` (State 0 table) vs A11 resolution refusal
open_points.text: State 0: "resolve an unknown outcome ... | —" (no failure). State 2 A11 rule 3: "Resolving is refused unless the named attempt's EffectAttempt is `unknown` and its run has not ended."
open_points.question: Can `resolve unknown outcome` be refused, or must it always succeed as State 0 implies?
options: Keep State 0 literal: no refusal path for resolve.
Keep A11: refuse when attempt is not `unknown` or run has ended.
open_points.default_guess: Keep A11 (later, explicit rule with concrete conditions).

open_points.subject: Action `accept a binding` (State 0 table) vs A08 acceptance checks
open_points.text: State 0: "accept a binding | owner | accepted binding; accepting an accepted binding returns it | —". State 2 A08 rule 7 adds refusals (unknown `binding_id`, stale/mismatch checks).
open_points.question: Should `accept binding` have no domain refusals, or should it refuse on unknown/stale/mismatch as A08 states?
options: No domain refusal beyond auth/schema; always return accepted binding.
Refuse on unknown binding and on manifest checks in A08 rule 7.

open_points.subject: Flow input/output carriage constraint enforcement
open_points.text: A05 phase 3 says edge checks include "a flow input or output is `value` carriage"; A05 rule 7 says composition pre-proof only refuses repeated ids/names; M13 says flow inputs/outputs are always `value` carriage.
open_points.question: If a composed flow declares a flow input/output with `file` carriage but that port is not part of any checked edge, must composition/proof refuse it?
options: Refuse any flow version containing non-`value` flow I/O ports regardless of connectivity.
Only fail when such a port appears in an edge check; otherwise version may pass.
open_points.default_guess: Refuse any non-`value` flow I/O port at composition/proof input validation.

open_points.subject: Mapped-node progress across multiple advance requests
open_points.text: A13 rule 2: "A mapped node, once selected, runs every element it can in list order before the next node is selected; an element that waits or fails does not stop the elements after it."
open_points.question: When the run advances again (approval/resume/restart) and the mapped node is still unconcluded, are already-concluded elements re-executed or skipped?
options: Never re-execute concluded elements; execute only elements without a concluded attempt or those explicitly retried by rule.
Allow re-execution of previously concluded elements when node is selected again.
